_doc: Default promotions (requirement 9). templateId is a built-in from config-api/src/builtins.js. Seasonal (promo ID occasions, kept so existing campaign URLs keep working) plays the season whose dates hold today, else the season its template names (Christmas when seeded; the admin editor's Season drop-down changes it). masterFrom is the store code of the pharmacy whose fixture content is the promotion's master template, which every pharmacy inherits (requirement 23).
